senses.gloss: to be zealous for; to be jealous; to suspect of unfaithfulness.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 5:14">Targ. Num. V, 14</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to make jealous. Targ. II Esth. II, 19 קַנְּאָהּ וכ׳ (ed. קָנְאָה, ed. Vien. קָנְאָתָּהּ) make her jealous by marrying other wives.

units: <cite ref="Sotah 2b:23">Sot. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>זמנין דלא ק׳ ואמר קַנָּאִי</he> it may happen that he did not warn her and yet he may declare, I did warn her.
<cite ref="Sotah 2b:29">Ib.</cite> <he>וכ״ע ידעי דק׳ לה</he> and all will know that he did warn her; a. fr.
